name: Requesty
summary: Gateway with organization-wide free-model request allowance and separate PAYG access.

setupSteps.title: Create your own API key
setupSteps.description: Create an API key in your Requesty organization.

setupSteps.title: Pin free provider routes
setupSteps.description: Use a full provider/model ID, review current model pricing and disable any fallback policy that can select paid or unknown routes.

setupSteps.title: Review data policy
setupSteps.description: Review Training Permitted Models metadata before sending content; free plan data handling can differ by model.

billingPlans.name: Free models · organization pool
billingPlans.resetDescription: Daily; exact reset timestamp unknown until observed.
billingPlans.notes: Shared across all free models. Paying organizations: 1,000/day and 60/minute; this does not establish the user organization tier or its remaining requests.

billingPlans.name: PAYG
billingPlans.notes: Separate from free allowance; upstream pricing plus gateway markup. No current credit-balance endpoint qualified.

routes.name: Nemotron 3 Super · documented free
routes.freeOnlyEnforcement: Pin the exact documented provider/model ID; reject bare aliases and policy/* routers. Recheck current price and provider routing before free-only activation.
restrictions: Snapshot price is documented, current endpoint metadata and account routing policy remain unqualified.
